1. The Person in Charge is knowledgeable and demonstrating food safety practices with a ServSafe or local equivalent certification.
2. The Person in Charge supervising food safety practices, ensuring that all proper food safety practices are being followed by all Team Members on shift.
3. Ill Team Members properly restricted or excluded from the establishment.
4. All eating, drinking, and tobacco use is done in designated areas away from food and dishwashing stations.
5. All Team Members are wearing a hair restraint and/or hairnet with a Jersey Mike's hat or visor.
6. All Team Members are following the uniform guidelines on jewelry-wearing prohibitions.
7. All Team Members are following the uniform guidelines for fingernails being short, clean, and trimmed with false nails not being permitted.
8. Team Members are washing hands.
9. Team Members are washing hands only in the designated hand sink stations.
10. Hand sinks are free of debris and supplied with soap, a drying method, and trash container.
11. No bare hand contact with Ready-to-Eat foods.
12. During preparation and while in storage, foods are stored in proper order to prevent raw meats and poultry from contaminating Ready-to-Eat foods.
13. Food is only handled with clean and sanitized equipment, utensils, and linens.
14. Team Members are changing gloves when contaminated, changing tasks, or after 4 hours of continuous use.

section: TCS FOODS (TIME AND TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFE)
item: 15. Any frozen foods items such as steaks, and bacon, are thawed in the refrigerator.

section: TCS FOODS (TIME AND TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFE)
item: 16. Thermometers are accessible and calibrated for monitoring food temperatures.

section: TCS FOODS (TIME AND TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFE)
item: 17. All TCS foods are being held at temperatures of 41°F or below in walk-in, meat case, drop-ins, sandwich unit, and freezer.

section: TCS FOODS (TIME AND TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFE)
item: 18. TCS foods received at 41°F or below.
19. Chemicals are clearly labeled with contents and stored in a way to prevent contamination.
help: All chemicals are not stored above food, equipment, utensils, linen, and single-service articles.

item: 20. Date-marking
help: Ready-to-Eat TCS foods (deli meats, cheeses, backup containers for drop-ins, other TCS foods) are dated with the Use-by-Date or manufacturer's date, after receiving / cooking / cooling. Applies to all refrigeration units - walk-in, meat case, drop-ins, sandwich unit, and freezer.

item: 21. Expiration Dates
help: All deli meats, cheeses, backup containers in drop-ins, and other Ready-to-Eat foods are within expiration dates in all refrigeration units. Applies to all refrigeration units - walk-in, meat case, drop-ins, sandwich unit, and freezer.

item: 22. Condiment Protection
help: Dressing and condiment bottles are replaced with substitute bottles, not refilled. (Bottles are washed, rinsed, and sanitized once emptied) Applies to sauces, vinegar, oil, oregano, and salt shakers.

item: 23. Food Rotation
help: Deli meats, cheeses, backup containers and other TCS foods are stored in First In / First Out order and rotated by date in all refrigeration units - walk-in, meat case, drop-ins, sandwich unit, and freezer.

item: 24. All food containers are properly labeled with the Use-by-Date.
25. Sanitizer buckets contain the proper chemical solution with test strips available and in use.
26. Towels are stored in sanitizer buckets in-between uses and kept separated after handling raw foods.
27. Onions, lettuce, tomatoes, celery, and green bell peppers are washed in potable water.
28. All foods are stored in a clean and dry location with no splash, dust, or other contamination.
29. Food prepping stations are protected from all contaminating chemicals and other hazards during preparation.

section: PROPER STORAGE OF CLEAN UTENSILS, LINENS
item: 30. Utensils, equipment, wiping cloths, linens, and single-use items are stored in clean, dry location that are protected from contamination.
31. Three bay sinks are clean and ready for dishwashing with no unnecessary items in the sinks.
32. Chemical sanitizer in the sanitizing sink has the proper concentration with test strips available and in use.
33. All equipment, food contact surfaces, and utensils are cleaned properly to sight and touch.
34. All equipment and oven surfaces around the grill and grill prep area have no grease build up or accumulation of debris.
35. All refuse and trash is stored in covered containers (dumpsters) with the areas clean and maintained.
36. Restrooms contain working toilet, hand sink, soap, tissue, and receptacle.
37. Mops and brooms are hung after use to prevent contamination.
help: Cleaning tools are stored away from food areas to dry.

item: 38. Food prep areas clear of unnecessary items and litter.
39. No cracks or spaces for pest entry exist on any screens, doors, windows, or vents.
help: Areas clear of collection of debris, boxes, and trash that can contribute to pest harborage.
